question.problem: Suppose that $|\,c\,|=16$, $|\,d\,|=4$ and that the angle between the vectors is $\theta ={60}^{∘}.$ Find the vector projection of $c$ onto $d$ in terms of the vector $d.$
question.worked_solution:
First, we find the scalar projection as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{comp}}_{d}\,c & =|\,c\,|\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta  \\  & =16\operatorname{cos}⁡({60}^{∘}) \\  & =16\cdot \frac{1}{2} \\  & =8\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we find the unit vector that is parallel to $d:$

$$
u=\frac{d}{|\,d\,|}=\frac{d}{4}=\frac{1}{4}d
$$

Finally, we compute the vector projection as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{d}\,c & ={\text{comp}}_{d}\,c\cdot u \\  & =8\cdot \frac{1}{4}d \\  & =2d\end{aligned}
$$
